critique: The render has the correct black-background ember palette and the particles do drift downward between t1 and t4, but it reads as a tiny, sparse cluster of pixel-sized dots near the center rather than the visibly substantial falling-sparks shower expected from the preset thumbnail. Spark coverage, brightness, and apparent particle scale are all far too low; the short lifetime also keeps the falling trail compact.

suggestions.why: Increase the one-pixel particle size so the fire-gradient sparks read as visible glowing embers rather than near-invisible pinpoints.
Lengthen particle lifetime to build a sustained downward shower and a more pronounced falling trail under gravity.
Raise emission density so the effect resembles a continuous cascade of sparks instead of a small scattered clump.
